claims.text: The deviation is established on this trip's own telemetry. The GPS trace measures the polyline actually driven at 54.16 km against a booked optimal of 36.0 km, an excess of 18.16 km, and 18.16 km is both greater than 0.8 km and 50.44% of the optimal, so both limbs of the establishment test pass and the excess is in addition a MATERIAL deviation. The excess is measured from gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which governs over the rounded trip_record copy under POL-RD-01.

Nothing in the bundle picks the deviation up as a rider-requested detour. The chat log holds two rider queries and one non-answer from the driver, no waypoint_hint is set on any message, and no place or road is named by the rider, so the corroboration test in POL-RD-04 cannot be run on the record and that clause is unavailable to the driver. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded either: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has no purchase and the 36.0 km booked optimal stands as the baseline.

The burden has shifted to the driver and he has not discharged it. The three primary artifacts all carry the trip identifier TRP-00105, and the rider has shown an excess over threshold on an unimpaired trace, so under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12. He has pointed to none, and a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the burden.

The driver's stated excuse - 'Traffic was heavy on the PIE so I used another way' - cannot be tested against anything, because no traffic advisory covers this trip. The sole advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00105-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload: its own admissibility detail records that no LTA advisory covers the PIE eastbound in the 14:26-15:44 window on 15 July 2026, and the driver's assertion names no artifact. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else; with no such advisory the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no advisory evidence ID, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it does not trigger escalation; the deviation simply stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The trace is not impaired, so nothing stands between the rider and the measured figure. It carries 427 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, coverage_pct of 100.0, zero gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met and no corroboration requirement arises. The fare_breakdown's billed 54.2 km is not needed as an independent source, and the trace's 54.16 km independently corroborates it in any event.

The money follows arithmetically. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 36.0 + 0.28 x 42.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = (3.80 + 27.00 + 11.76) + 0.80 = 43.36, with no ERP, toll or airport surcharge line to add because the optimal route carries zero ERP and this trip terminates at Changi rather than originating there. Charged_total is 65.13, so the refund is 65.13 - 43.36 = 21.77, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and rounds up to SGD 21.80. No exculpatory clause reduces the excess, so the computation runs against the booked 36.0 km optimal.

The engine agrees with that arithmetic to the cent and the rider does not contest it: the fare_breakdown's own derived block returns a recomputed_fare of 43.3600 and a refund_before_rounding of 21.7700, payable 21.80, which is 33.43% of the 65.13 charged. I therefore do not put the rider to proof on the quantum of the partial refund, and I record that the figure is traceable line by line and re-checkable by hand rather than a round-number goodwill payment.

The quantum the rider asked for is a full refund of the whole 65.13, and POL-RD-06 is what makes that more than a wish: the driver's profile records deviation_flags_90d of 4, which is 3 or more, so a pattern is ESTABLISHED on the clause's own primary test. The profile artifact is IMPAIRED - issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT, snapshot taken 2026-07-11T08:00:00+08:00, 108 hours before filing against a 72 hour threshold, weight_multiplier 0.75 - and I disclose that, but the finding survives the discount because the count is 4 against a threshold of 3. Only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d are relied on for this test; prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and I do not use it. Because this trip's deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on the trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) licenses FULL_REFUND of charged_total of 65.13 rather than the POL-RD-02 partial, and the ruling should state the POL-RD-02 figure of 21.80 and the uplifted figure of 65.13 side by side so the size of the uplift is visible. POL-RD-06(c) additionally requires the case to be referred to driver-conduct review.

No pass-through or billing-integrity line needs to be unpicked here, and I say so because it would be easy to invent one. erp_gantries is empty and the derived ERP block reports zero on-route and zero off-route, so POL-RD-09(1) has nothing to double-count and POL-RD-09(2) has nothing to cap; and the airport_surcharge line is 0.0, which is correct rather than defective, because the Changi surcharge applies to trips originating at the airport and this trip ends there. The refund is therefore not entangled with any third-party line.

The governing distance is the trace, not the rounded trip_record copy: under POL-RD-01 the field for the threshold test is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 54.16 km on an unbroken 10-second trace with 100% coverage and no gaps, and against the 36.0 km booked optimal that is a measured excess of 18.16 km. That measured figure - and nothing larger - is what feeds the fare recomputation on this trip.

The rider asks for the entire fare back; POL-RD-02 does not produce that. charged_total is SGD 65.13, recomputed_fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 36.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 42.0 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 43.36, and the refund is 65.13 - 43.36 = SGD 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 payable. That is 33.4% of the charge, well short of the 90% that would make FULL_REFUND available under POL-RD-02, so SGD 43.36 of the fare stands on the clause's own arithmetic.

No pass-through or billing-integrity line enlarges that refund. The fare_breakdown carries a nil airport surcharge - correctly, because the Changi surcharge attaches to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this trip terminates there - and a nil ERP total with no gantry lines and no phantom charge, so POL-RD-09(4) finds no standalone billing item to correct, and POL-RD-09(1) has no off-route ERP to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

Any uplift from the POL-RD-02 partial to a FULL_REFUND would have to come from POL-RD-06(b), and that uplift rests exclusively on the driver profile EV-DPROF-00105, which the admissibility pre-pass has IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.75 with issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (a snapshot taken 108 hours before the dispute against a 72 hour threshold). Under POL-GEN-02(3) that artifact must be named and its discount openly tested rather than the counter treated as current, and under POL-GEN-02(2) it caps confidence in any pattern-dependent remedy; the clean weight-1.0 artifacts support only the measured SGD 21.80, not a reversal of the whole SGD 65.13.

The driver's explanation for the detour ('traffic was heavy on the PIE') names no advisory and cites no evidence id, so it is weightless under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-03 is unavailable; but the very same fact means the absent advisory EV-ADVIS-00105-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0) is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact and does not fire the mandatory escalation in POL-RD-10(5) - a party cannot invoke an artifact it never cited. The case is therefore decided on the money at the POL-RD-02 figure rather than escalated with the disputed amount held.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your route-deviation claim is upheld, and you receive the whole contested fare back.

Liability. The 10-second GPS trace for TRP-00105 (EV-GPS-00105, unbroken, 427 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 sec) measures the driven polyline at 54.16 km against the 36.0 km booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-00105 — an excess of 18.16 km, which is over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km, and is also over both 50% and 8.0 km, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL under POL-RD-01. The trace figure governs over the rounded 54.2 km copy, as POL-RD-01 requires. Nothing excuses it: there is no rider-requested detour and no rider place or road in the chat log (EV-CHAT-00105 holds two rider queries and one non-answer, with waypoint_hint null on every message), so POL-RD-04 cannot be run and is unavailable; and no pickup or dropoff was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, amended_optimal_distance_km is null), so POL-RD-05 has no purchase and the 36.0 km baseline stands. The trip is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply, and the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply.

The arithmetic. Under POL-RD-02 read on the METERED fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-00105), recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 36.0 km + 0.28 x 42.0 min) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee = 43.36, with no ERP, toll, surcharge or waiting line to add. Charged_total is 65.13, so the POL-RD-02 refund is 65.13 - 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 payable — above the 0.50 de minimis and 33.4% of the charge, so POL-RD-02 alone would not reach the 90% that FULL_REFUND needs. I state that figure so the uplift below is auditable.

Why the whole fare. You asked for the full 65.13, and POL-RD-06 is what carries it. Your driver's profile records deviation_flags_90d of 4 against a threshold of 3, so a repeat-deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED on the clause's own primary test, and because this trip's deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on the trip's own telemetry, POL-RD-06(b) uplifts the remedy from the 21.80 partial to a FULL_REFUND of the 65.13 charged (no government-set or third-party pass-through lines are present to be held back). The two figures side by side: POL-RD-02 figure 21.80; POL-RD-06(b) uplifted figure 65.13.

To the driver: your explanation that traffic was heavy on the PIE is not supported by anything in the bundle. No traffic advisory covers this trip — EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 — and you named no evidence ID for one. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the flight's advisory and nothing else, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and a general assertion of bad traffic unsupported by an advisory ID carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because you cited no advisory, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so the case is decided on the money rather than escalated with the amount held. The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes (no gap over 90 sec, no jump over 500 m, no sampling interval over 30 sec), so POL-RD-07 imposes no corroboration requirement and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The remaining POL-RD-10 triggers do not fire: the trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the timestamps are consistent and run forward, and no charge line lacks a counterpart (the nil airport surcharge is correct, because the Changi surcharge attaches to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this one terminates there, and erp_gantries is empty).

On the profile evidence. The pattern finding rests on EV-DPROF-00105, which the pre-pass marked IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.75 with issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (snapshot 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour threshold). The finding survives the discount, because 4 flags clear the threshold of 3, but under POL-GEN-02 the impairment caps confidence in this pattern-dependent remedy at 0.75. Only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d were used for the test; prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is context only, not a ground.

No billing-integrity referral arises under POL-RD-09(4): there is no phantom gantry line and no wrongly applied surcharge. The one referral is required by POL-RD-06(c).

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the trip was a material route deviation and the entire SGD 65.13 charged is refunded, with the driver's conduct referred for review.

The deviation is established on this trip's own telemetry. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is the trace, not the rounded trip-record copy: EV-GPS-00105 records 54.16 km on a complete 10-second trace (427 fixes, 100% coverage, zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0) against the 36.0 km booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00105 — a measured excess of 18.16 km. That is greater than 0.8 km and 50.44% of the optimal, so both establishment tests pass, and the excess is additionally MATERIAL (over 50% and over 8.0 km). The rider's figure of 4 km of detour (36 km usual vs 54 km driven) matches the trace.

The driver's explanation ('traffic was heavy on the PIE') does not displace this. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory evidence ID, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it does not trigger escalation under POL-RD-10(5); the deviation stands at the measured figure. POL-RD-04 (rider-requested detour) and POL-RD-05 (point relocation) are likewise unavailable: EV-CHAT-00105 holds two rider queries and one non-answer with no waypoint_hint and no place or road named, and pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null.

The POL-RD-02 arithmetic (uncontested, and matching the fare_breakdown derived block to the cent): recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 36.0 + 0.28 × 42.0) × 1.0 surge read from EV-FARE-00105) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 43.36; charged_total SGD 65.13 less 43.36 = SGD 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 payable, being 33.4% of the charge. On POL-RD-02 alone the outcome would be the partial refund of SGD 21.80. No pass-through or billing line alters it: the ERP block on EV-FARE-00105 is zero with no gantry lines and the airport surcharge is correctly nil (the Changi surcharge attaches to trips originating at the airport and this trip terminates there), so POL-RD-09 gives no standalone correction and no billing-integrity referral.

The full refund comes from POL-RD-06(b): the deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, and a pattern is established because driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 4 (three or more). That limb licenses FULL_REFUND of charged_total — SGD 65.13 — rather than the POL-RD-02 partial of SGD 21.80; both figures are printed here so the SGD 43.33 uplift is auditable. There are no government-set or third-party pass-through lines (ERP, tolls, airport surcharge) to exclude from the uplift.

I must disclose the condition of the artifact the uplift rests on. EV-DPROF-00105 is IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.75 with issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT: its snapshot is dated 2026-07-11T08:00:00+08:00, 108 hours before filing, past the 72-hour threshold, so the counters may lag the driver's state at trip time. ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both of you. It explains what the trip evidence shows, why the driver's explanation does not reduce the excess, and how the fare is settled.

WHAT THE TRACE SHOWS. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00105) records the route actually driven at 54.16 km against a booked optimal of 36.0 km from the trip record (EV-TRIP-00105) — an excess of 18.16 km, or 50.44% of the optimal. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs over the rounded trip-record copy (54.2 km). Both establishment limbs pass: the excess is greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% of optimal. It is also greater than 8.0 km and greater than 50%, so the deviation is additionally MATERIAL and the driver_profile check in POL-RD-06 is required. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 427 fixes, a 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a max gap of 0.0 s, so none of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is met and no independent-corroboration requirement arises.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver says traffic was heavy on the PIE and he used another way. That assertion names no traffic advisory and cites no evidence ID. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00105-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route, and the ruling records that no advisory was on file. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire and this case is not escalated. On the rider's side, the chat log (EV-CHAT-00105) holds two rider queries and one non-answer, with no waypoint hint and no place or road named, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable; and no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded (pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null), so POL-RD-05 does not run. No exculpatory clause reduces the excess.

THE MONEY. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 × 36.0 optimal km + 0.28 × 42.0 optimal min) × the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown EV-FARE-00105) + 0.80 platform fee = 43.36. Charged_total is 65.13, so the POL-RD-02 partial refund is 65.13 − 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 payable — 33.4% of the charge, short of the 90% that would give a full refund under POL-RD-02 alone. There are no ERP or toll charges to correct and the nil airport surcharge is correct, not defective: the Changi surcharge attaches only to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this trip ends there. POL-RD-09 therefore corrects nothing and adds nothing.

THE UPLIFT. POL-RD-06 changes the outcome. The driver profile (EV-DPROF-00105) records deviation_flags_90d = 4, which meets the clause's 3-or-more test, so a repeat-deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED. Because this trip's deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) licenses FULL_REFUND of the charged total rather than the POL-RD-02 partial. The POL-RD-02 figure is SGD 21.80; the uplifted figure is SGD 65.13, and both are stated here so the size of the uplift is visible. That profile artifact is impaired — issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT, its snapshot taken 2026-07-11, 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour threshold, weight_multiplier 0.75 — and I have tested the discount openly rather than treating the counter as current: 4 flags against a threshold of 3 means the pattern survives the discount, so the uplift stands, but the impairment caps confidence in this ruling at 0.75, which is above the 0.70 escalation floor. Only deviation_flags_90d is relied on for this test; prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is not used.

OUTCOME. I refund the whole contested amount, SGD 65.13. The driver's submission that only the SGD 21.80 partial is supported is outweighed: the partial is right on POL-RD-02's arithmetic, but POL-RD-06(b) uplifts it to the full charged total on this trip's own evidence. Because POL-RD-06(c) requires it, the case is referred to driver-conduct review; that referral rides with the refund and neither delays nor displaces it.
referrals: POL-RD-06(c): refer to driver-conduct review — this trip's deviation is MATERIAL and substantiated on its own trace, and the driver's profile records a repeat-deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d = 4).

The rider asks for the entire fare back; POL-RD-02 does not produce that. charged_total is SGD 65.13, recomputed_fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 36.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 42.0 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge_multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 43.36, and the refund is 65.13 - 43.36 = SGD 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 payable. That is 33.4% of the charge, well short of the 90% that would make FULL_REFUND available under POL-RD-02, so SGD 43.36 of the fare stands on the clause's own arithmetic.

No pass-through or billing-integrity line enlarges that refund. The fare_breakdown carries a nil airport surcharge - correctly, because the Changi surcharge attaches to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this trip terminates there - and a nil ERP total with no gantry lines and no phantom charge, so POL-RD-09(4) finds no standalone billing item to correct, and POL-RD-09(1) has no off-route ERP to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

Any uplift from the POL-RD-02 partial to a FULL_REFUND would have to come from POL-RD-06(b), and that uplift rests exclusively on the driver profile EV-DPROF-00105, which the admissibility pre-pass has IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.75 with issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (a snapshot taken 108 hours before the dispute against a 72 hour threshold). Under POL-GEN-02(3) that artifact must be named and its discount openly tested rather than the counter treated as current, and under POL-GEN-02(2) it caps confidence in any pattern-dependent remedy; the clean weight-1.0 artifacts support only the measured SGD 21.80, not a reversal of the whole SGD 65.13.

The driver's explanation for the detour ('traffic was heavy on the PIE') names no advisory and cites no evidence id, so it is weightless under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-03 is unavailable; but the very same fact means the absent advisory EV-ADVIS-00105-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0) is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact and does not fire the mandatory escalation in POL-RD-10(5) - a party cannot invoke an artifact it never cited. The case is therefore decided on the money at the POL-RD-02 figure rather than escalated with the disputed amount held.
